propositions: Symbol-level units from jira_fields.py, identity.py, and probe.py that carry no by-path load references must be moved from adapters/jira/ to a new adapters/jira_family/ package to establish a sanctioned Jira-family shared seam and eliminate unsanctioned cross-adapter imports.

jira_fields.py must split by symbol: _sanitize_label, _sanitize_summary, InvalidLabelError, _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, and value-map literals move to jira_family/; _sanitize_description and _sanitize_comment move as contract-parameterized functions; Cloud's jira_fields.py survives as the contract-construction site.

The classified probe response logic must move to jira_family/ as classify_probe_response with resolved-status set injected as a required keyword-only parameter, while RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES and the live probe() stay in adapters/jira/probe.py to preserve J1's oracle pins and prevent DC misclassification.

The local→Jira status and priority map definitions must unify into a single source in jira_family/ adopted by both ACLI transport and backend.py, with deleted status resolved to Done matching outbound_fields and config.py, eliminating the pre-existing duplicate-and-drifted copies.

Location-pinned modules adf.py, outbound_fields.py, and comment_limits.py must not move; instead they import from jira_family/ using absolute imports only, and the dynamic loader path contract is preserved with _loader.py unchanged.

Every importer of moved symbols and every mock.patch target must be updated to the new paths with no re-export shims left behind, acli*.py modified only in import lines, and a persistent AST-based test enforcing the acyclic import graph.
